messages:
alan: Noticed invoice vs console preview mismatch for tenant `zephyr-co`. Preview ~1.7M tokens, invoice ~1.53M. Started after the 'rollforward' of route sampling at 23:40 UTC.
rita: Which services got the rollforward? cc @sophia-console
alan: edge-router and preview-aggregator. The finalizer (billing-join) still on previous release.
omar: That can explain it. Preview emits sampled events with tag `sample_v3`; finalizer expects `sample_v2_id`. Join fails -> we fall back to full-count logic but with different scale.
vyas-billing: On billing side: we reconstruct counts by applying scale = round(1 / p) at aggregation time. If preview used exact 1/p and finalizer used rounded scale you get consistent but different numbers. Mid-window rollforward makes it worse.
sophia-console: I see two problems: 1) join key name changed (`sample_id` -> `sample_v3`), 2) preview updated sampling prob from 0.015 -> 0.012. Preview dashboard shows 'estimated tokens' using live sampling meta, invoice uses stored sampling config snapshot from finalizer.
product-ops: Customer impact? Any invoices already billed?
alan: Affected window is last 4 hours; a few customers on streaming-heavy plans. Immediate difference ~10-12%.
sophia-console: Quick mitigation: revert preview-aggregator sampling tag to `sample_v2_id` and align probability to 0.015 until billing-join is upgraded. I can push a config hotfix.
omar: If we do that we should also backfill the preview event stream for the 4h window to match invoice semantics so support/CS doesn't get confused.
vyas-billing: Also propose adding metadata field `sampling_config_version` on events so finalizer can use config version rather than rely on service roll order.
sophia-console: Good call. I'll open PR for sampling_config_version and a migration path.
alan: For now, please do the hotfix. @deploy-bot can you gate the rollout?
deploy-bot: Deployment request queued: revert sampling tag on preview-aggregator. ID: D-20260320-77. ETA ~12m.
rita: Heads-up to finance ops: potential invoice deltas during this window. We may need to run reconciliation if delta > 5%.
vyas-billing: I'll run a diff job once hotfix is live. If >5% we'll trigger manual invoice adjust job for the window and notify accounts.
product-ops: Please prepare an internal incident note for CS with exact tenants.
sophia-console: Hotfix applied at 1732123600, sampler tag and prob restored. Monitoring dashboards: preview vs finalizer token ratio trending toward 1.0.
alan: Thanks. Filing an action item: add automated test that simulates mid-window sampling probability flip and verifies final scale deterministicization.
omar: Also adding a lint rule to disallow renaming sampling join keys without a migration flag.
sophia-console: PRs for tests + sampling_config_version linked in the rollup.
vyas-billing: Reconciliation job scheduled 1732124000. I'll post results here when done.
